title: Ceará vs. Novorizontino: a match that could change the 29th round
subtitle: The clash could define the lead and the Grandfather's position in the competition
excerpt: Last Friday, Ceará faced Novorizontino at Arena Castelão in Fortaleza, in a match for the 29th round of Série B.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Last Friday, Ceará faced Novorizontino at Arena Castelão in Fortaleza, in a match for the 29th round of Série B. The game had implications for the standings and the history of both teams.

Match Scenario

The match was characterized by a points dispute that could alter the league table's hierarchy. Ceará, who finished the last round with a draw against Fortaleza, occupies 15th position with 32 points. Novorizontino, who also drew with Cuiabá, leads the competition with 50 points, extending their advantage over the others.

Head-to-Head History

The two clubs have met five times in 2026. Ceará has three losses and two wins in Série B, while Novorizontino has three wins and two losses. Their last encounter, in 2023, ended in a draw, and the Grandfather won both games in 2024.

Coaches on the Field

Daniel Paulista, from Ceará, and Enderson Moreira, from Novorizontino, have faced each other on 10 occasions. The record shows one victory for Daniel, five for Enderson, and four draws. The last duel between the two coaches occurred when Daniel was in charge of Goiás, which was defeated 4-0 by Enderson's team.

Impact on the Standings

The result could solidify Novorizontino's lead or create an opportunity for Ceará. With a 61% chance of securing direct promotion, Novorizontino has a seven-match unbeaten streak. Ceará, by maintaining 15th position, aims to avoid dropping further down the table.

Where to Watch Live

The game was broadcast live at 8:30 PM (Brasília time) from Arena Castelão in Fortaleza. Fans could follow the match in real-time through sports streaming platforms.

With information from Estadão, ge.
